title: Saul looked at David and saw a threat.
paragraphs:
Saul looked at David and saw a threat.
David looked at God and found his identity.

Comparison asks, “Why not me?”
Calling asks, “What have You given me?”

When does comparison become self-destruction?
And…
Is ambition different from envy?
“I will steward what God placed in me.”
“I resent what God placed in you.”

Ambition builds quietly.
Envy burns loudly.

One is fueled by purpose.
The other is fueled by insecurity.

The throne didn’t destroy Saul.
Comparison did.
